title: fix(runtime): comment doors answer on an `objectstack serve` / `objectstack dev` multi-tenant host instead of 404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8RVgGNY8UtzQKECmEjFw5Pi)_

Part of #36469

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户看到的变化：在本机托管环境（`objectstack dev` 启动的云端运行时）里，取消表情回应、标记已解决、删除自己的评论不再报「接口不存在」。
- 原因：上一个修复（#36539）只接通了生产那种启动方式；本机开发启动方式少一层兜底路由，请求到不了那条修复。
- 坏了会怎样：只影响这三个评论操作在多租户主机上的转发；单机自部署不受影响，其他找不到的路径照旧返回原来的 404。
- 需要你做什么：无；合并后云端下次升级平台版本即生效。

## What changes

**Measured finding.** Cloud's local rig runs `apps/objectos` under `objectstack dev`, the framework CLI's composition, which mounts no `createHonoApp` catch-all. On that host the three comment doors answer `404 {"success":false,"error":{"code":"ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND","message":"Not found"}}` whatever the framework pin, because #36539's `/comments` domain is reachable only through `dispatch()`. The gap is in this repo's `DispatcherPlugin`, so it reaches any multi-tenant host composed by `objectstack serve` / `objectstack dev`, not only cloud's rig.

The card's hosted reading was a literal `404 {"success":false,"error":{"code":"ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND","message":"Not found"}}` on `DELETE /api/v1/comments/reactions/:id`. #36539 left that spelling unexplained. This PR explains it and closes the gap it came from.

**Two host shapes serve a hosted environment.**

- Production and staging run cloud's `apps/objectos/server/serve-node.ts`. It mounts `createHonoApp({ prefix: '/api/v1' })` under the `HonoServerPlugin` raw app, so an unclaimed `/api/v1/comments/**` request reaches `dispatch()` and #36539's `/comments` domain. Cloud's `main` pin moved to objectstack `ed0edb1b5` on 2026-11-23 04:35Z (cloud#4929), which contains #36539 (`d463c46f64`). Whether that pin is deployed is cloud's fact and is not read here.
- Cloud's local rig (`scripts/dev-local/run-stack.sh`, default `START_CMD=dev`) runs `apps/objectos` under `objectstack dev`: the framework CLI's composition, which is `HonoServerPlugin` + `DispatcherPlugin` with a `kernel-resolver` and **no** `createHonoApp` catch-all. `AuditPlugin` runs on the per-environment kernel (cloud's `hosted-slate.ts` forces `audit`), which owns no `http.server`, so nothing mounts the doors on the host's route table. `DispatcherPlugin`'s fallback seam hands on only domain-decided paths (`/actions`, `/keys`, `/notifications`, `/mcp`) and app-endpoint paths, so it declined, and the transport's `unmatchedResponse` answered. That is the card's exact body. The card was measured on this rig.

**The fix**, in `@objectstack/runtime` only:

- `forwarded-door-fallback.ts` (new, internal): `matchForwardedDoorPath` says whether an unrouted request is exactly one of the three comment door shapes, bare or `/environments/:id`-scoped (it reuses `matchCommentDoorPath` from `domains/comments.ts`). `toWebRequest` rebuilds the fallback's `IHttpRequest` as a Web `Request` (headers, query, original body bytes via `rawBody()`). `sendWebResponse` writes the member's `Response` back unchanged, `Set-Cookie` lines kept separate.
- `DispatcherPlugin`'s fallback gains one arm, before the app-endpoint step: on a multi-tenant host, an exact door shape goes to `dispatch()` with the rebuilt request, and a `Response` result is written through. Everything after `dispatch()` is #36539's `/comments` domain, unchanged, including its authentication and membership gates.

What does not change:

- Any other shape still writes nothing in the fallback, so the transport's own 404/405 stands (#5090).
- A single-kernel host (no `kernel-resolver`) keeps today's answers byte for byte.
- The fallback runs only after every mounted route missed, so a kernel that mounts the doors itself (the self-hosted shape) is never reached here (ADR-0076 D11).
- No spec, contract or plugin change; no export added.

Clause-② is `no`: the arm routes only the three door shapes #36539 already declared (route ledger rows, `/comments` domain, `ICommentDoorsService`), with no new route, export or contract.

## Why

Card #36469 acceptance asks for the reaction removal, resolve/reopen and own-comment delete to work on a hosted environment, "本机 cloud rig 或 staging". After #36539 the staging shape works by construction, but the local rig, where the card was measured, still answered `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`.

## Verification

- `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.comment-doors-multi-tenant.test.ts` (new, 9): a real `HonoServerPlugin` + `DispatcherPlugin` over a socket with a `kernel-resolver` and a stub tenant member. Each door reaches the placed tenant's member, with the PUT body intact and the member's own headers on the answer. The environment-scoped spelling forwards at the wire path. Three non-door shapes (an extra segment, the wrong verb, GET) keep `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` and reach no member. An unplaced request is never served out of a tenant. A host with no resolver keeps `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`.
- `packages/qa/http-conformance/src/hono-comment-doors.conformance.test.ts` (+3, 9 total): the `objectstack serve` shape over the REAL `AuditPlugin` on a real store. A member removes their own reaction (200, row gone on the tenant). A member resolves, reopens, then removes their own comment (200 each, store follows). The anonymous refusal and the two refused bodies are byte-identical to the self-hosted mount.
- Red before the fix (the `dispatcher-plugin.ts` hunk removed, restore proved by `sha1 c3ac20dc…` before and after):
  - runtime file: 4 of 9 red (the 3 doors + the scoped spelling). The 5 that stay green are the miss and guard cases, which hold without the arm.
  - conformance file, runtime `dist` rebuilt without the arm: the 3 new cases red. Each answered `404 {"success":false,"error":{"code":"ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND","message":"Not found"}}`, the card's body byte for byte. Rebuilt with the arm: green.
- Suites: runtime `dispatcher-plugin*`, `*fallback*` and `route-ledger*`: 25 files, 205 tests green. `domains/comments.test.ts` + `dispatcher-plugin.multi-tenant-endpoint.integration.test.ts` green. http-conformance `hono-comment-doors` 9/9.
- Typecheck: http-conformance `typecheck` exit 0. Runtime `tsc --noEmit` exit 0 and the new test file clean under `tsconfig.test.json`. Runtime `check:test-typecheck` names 3 untouched files (TS2307 on the unbuilt `@objectstack/driver-turso`, not built in this worktree). The previous round on this card recorded the same 3.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on the 4 changed source files: exit 0.
- overlap-check: `origin/main` merges cleanly, 0 open PR heads share a file.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` at the base `4034a6d2f8` plus this diff: 68 derived, all run. 66 exited 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs every package's `dist/`), so it is NOT MEASURED here and left to CI. `check:test-source-alias` caught the new runtime test reaching `@objectstack/metadata` lazily inside a clocked case; fixed with a module-top import, now green.

## Not done here

- **Same class, same host shape, unmeasured:** every other dispatcher domain that only forwards to a tenant member has the same gap on an `objectstack dev` host: `/webhooks/redeliver`, `/approvals/act`, and the `/personal-views` and `/attachments` doors open in #36690. Each would be one matcher row in `FORWARDED_DOOR_MATCHERS`. This PR does not add them; the seat decides whether to file them or let #36690 add its own rows.
- **Live probe:** no hosted account here. The card's live acceptance (a reaction removed on the local rig or staging, and the `comment doors mounted` boot line) stays with the seat and the cloud lane.

- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
